question: In the year 2014, India was officially declared free of which of the following diseases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Polio.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the year 2014, India was officially declared free of Polio.
 
• India was declared Polio free on 27th March 2014 by the WHO
 
• India started a program named ''pulse polio'&
